findings.title: 'Silence notifications' menu item is shown in the ruler-less list view but clicking it does nothing
findings.body: In the new list view, GrafanaRuleListItem renders RuleActionsButtons with only `promRule` (no `rule`/rulerRule). AlertRuleMenu still shows the 'Silence notifications' item because `canSilence` can now be satisfied by the new useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(promRule) check. However, `handleSilence` only sets `showSilenceDrawer=true`, and the drawer is gated on `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` (line 104), which is false when no ruler rule is passed — so SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer is never rendered and the click silently does nothing. The newly added GrafanaGroupLoader test only asserts that the menu item is visible, not that it works, so it doesn't catch this. Either render a silence drawer that works from prom-rule data or hide the menu item when no rulerRule is available.

findings.title: GrafanaRuleListItem rendered without a React key in the filtered rule list
findings.body: In the `rules.map(...)` switch, the 'grafana' branch returns `<GrafanaRuleListItem>` without the `key={key}` prop that the previous `<GrafanaRuleLoader>` had (the 'datasource' and default branches still set `key`). React falls back to index-based reconciliation for grafana rows, so as pages are appended by infinite scroll and the 20s polling refresh re-renders rows, per-item state (open dropdown menus, drawers) can become attached to the wrong rule, and React logs a missing-key warning. Add `key={key}` to the grafana branch.

findings.title: Federated rule groups are no longer treated as immutable after the useAllAlertRuleAbilities refactor
findings.body: Before this change, `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` computed `isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)`, which made rules in Mimir federated groups (groups with `source_tenants`) non-editable/non-deletable in the UI. It now delegates to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities(rule.rulerRule, groupIdentifierV2)`, which hardcodes `const isFederated = false` with a TODO because the group object is no longer passed in. All existing consumers of `useAlertRuleAbility`/`useAllAlertRuleAbilities` (e.g. RuleActionsButtons, RulesTable, rule details) will now offer Edit/Delete/Pause for federated rules, and those operations will fail at the ruler API. Pass the group (or an isFederated flag) into useAllRulerRuleAbilities so the check is preserved.

findings.title: Duplicate/View abilities fall back to Grafana permissions for non-Grafana rules when rule is undefined (skipToken)
findings.body: When the prom rule is not a Grafana rule, callers pass `skipToken`, and `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` runs with `rule === undefined`. With no rule, `loading` is false, so `MaybeSupported` becomes `AlwaysSupported` and `[AlertRuleAction.Duplicate]` evaluates to `[true, has-grafana-create-permission]` using `getRulesPermissions('grafana')` (same for View with grafana read permission). AlertRuleMenu and RuleActionsButtons OR these abilities with the ruler-based ones, so for a cloud (Mimir/Loki) rule, a user who only has Grafana-managed rule create permission — but not `alert.rules.external:write` — will now see the Duplicate menu item; the actual operation will fail server-side. When the rule is undefined the hook should return all-false abilities instead of evaluating grafana permissions.

findings.title: Export (modify-export) and pause support dropped for Grafana recording rules in the list view
findings.body: The ruler-based ability used `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rule)` — true for both Grafana alerting and recording rules — to gate `ModifyExport`, `Pause` and `Restore`. The new `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` gates these on `prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)`, which is false for recording rules, even though modify-export and pausing are supported for Grafana recording rules elsewhere. Because the list view no longer fetches ruler rules, the OR fallback in AlertRuleMenu can't compensate, so Grafana recording rules lose the Export menu item in the list (and the Pause ability now reports unsupported). Use the recording-inclusive type guard where the ruler version used `grafana.rule`.

findings.title: Rule view link lost the returnTo parameter
findings.body: The removed GrafanaRuleLoader built the rule href with `createRelativeUrl(`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view`, { returnTo })` using createReturnTo(); the new GrafanaRuleListItem builds the same URL without `returnTo`. Navigating back from a rule to the list no longer restores the user's previous list location/filter state. Restore the `returnTo` query parameter.

findings.title: Stale comment about preloading ruler rules after the prefetch was removed
findings.body: The comment 'This is not mandatory to preload ruler rules, but it improves the UX…' and the variable name `cacheAndRulerPreload` still describe ruler preloading, but the `alertRuleApi.util.prefetch('getGrafanaRulerGroup', …)` call was removed in this PR. The comment/name is now misleading about what the code does and should be updated.
